Classic.label: TRADITIONAL + PERSONAL
Classic.description: A smaller, beautifully personalized traditional mum.

Signature.label: OUR SIGNATURE EXPERIENCE
Signature.description: A full-size custom mum with more ribbon, texture and personality.

Deluxe.label: BIG TEXAS ENERGY
Deluxe.description: Oversized, extra-detailed and built to make people ask where you got it.

Showstopper.label: TELL US YOUR VISION
Showstopper.description: Our most elaborate custom work. Individually designed and quoted.

policies.title: 50% Deposit
policies.body: A nonrefundable design/material deposit reserves the order. Specialty-material orders may require a larger deposit.

policies.title: Design Changes
policies.body: Changes after materials or design are approved may require a change fee and are subject to material availability.

policies.title: Rush Orders
policies.body: Rush orders may carry an additional fee and are accepted only when schedule and materials allow.

policies.title: Final Balance
policies.body: Remaining balance is due before pickup unless another arrangement has been confirmed.

senior.heading: Four years. One final homecoming.
senior.body: Senior mums can incorporate their name, Class of 2027, school, mascot, sports, clubs, accomplishments, photos, custom ribbon, premium metallics and the memories that defined high school.

hero.eyebrow: PREMIUM • PERSONALIZED • ONE OF A KIND
hero.body: Every Heart & Soul mum is designed around the student wearing it — their school, colors, personality, activities, accomplishments and homecoming memories.

difference.heading: A wearable keepsake of their high-school experience.
difference.body: Names, sports, clubs, jersey numbers, school pride, favorite things, photos, custom ribbon and personal details can all become part of the design.
difference.tagline: Don’t see it? Ask us. If we can make it, we’ll put it on your mum.

referral.reward_text: Free Classic mum after 5 fully paid, non-refunded qualifying orders.
